description.label: FAQ Description
description.default: Everything you need to know before joining premium.

default.title: How does the free trial work?
default.content: Click any trial button and you land in our Discord server, where the member channels are. Try it there. No card is taken for the trial, so there is nothing to cancel and no charge to forget about. Subscribe on Whop when you are ready.

default.title: Can I cancel anytime?
default.content: Yes — cancel from your Stripe customer portal at any time. Your access stays until the end of the current billing period.

default.title: What makes the premium feed different?
default.content: Premium members get faster alerts plus priority notifications for price errors, penny deals and reselling opportunities that stay out of the public feed.

default.title: Are the deals guaranteed?
default.content: No. Retailers can correct pricing errors at any time, and stock is often limited. Deals are posted fast specifically so you can act before that happens.

default.title: Is there a yearly plan?
default.content: Yes — choose the yearly plan for $200/year and save $100 compared to monthly billing. You get the same premium features with a full year of uninterrupted access.
